text: Could you use a clear frame from the attached clip to make a thumbnail for me, and pick the frame yourself rather than having me choose one? I’m hoping this will make the video feel a little more inviting when people first come across it. What I need is a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail, with me kept recognisable and the exact words “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in big letters beside my face. I always get a bit nervous about how I’ll look in a still pulled from a video. Please make the thumbnail warm and upbeat.
